text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing our errands, as Gentildonna
and I were walking toward the station—
an incident occurred.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash! Smash!!)
Everything in that showcase! Pack in as much as you can!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: So it seems.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking toward the sound, men in ski masks
were smashing display cases with metal bats,
stuffing luxury jewelry and watches into bags.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The jewelry store with the robbers is just a stone's throw away.
Prioritizing our safety, I try to lead Gentildonna away from the scene, but—

text_block_list.name: Balaclava-Wearing Man A
text_block_list.text: "This is more than enough! Let's pack up and head back!"

text_block_list.name: Balaclava-Wearing Man B
text_block_list.text: Out of the way! Wait, an Umamusume...!?

text_block_list.name: Balaclava-Wearing Man A
text_block_list.text:
Don't flinch! We've got a bat!
No matter how strong she is, one good whack'll do the trick!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho... What a remarkably bold thing to say.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Dangerous? What is?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Dangerous? What is?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how you looked at it, she was undoubtedly stronger than any robber.
Still, as her Trainer, I couldn't allow my trainee to be put in danger—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Balaclava-Wearing Man B
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!? You stole my bat!?

text_block_list.name: Balaclava-Wearing Man A
text_block_list.text: Don't get cocky just because you're a bit strong! In that case, take this knife...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that looks just about right for cutting an apple.
And? With that tiny knife—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: To me...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: What are—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Do you intend to do so?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No one could utter a sound.
After all, she had bent, twisted, and torn
a metal bat apart as if it were spun sugar."

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
Police! Quietly follow my instructi...
Wait, huh? What's going on here...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Faced with the bizarre sight of robbers utterly terrified and cowering before a single Umamusume, the police officers were equally bewildered. I quickly explained the situation and left the rest to them.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you stopping them from getting away,
all the stolen goods have been recovered.
I truly cannot thank you enough...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
I am simply glad your exquisite jewels
are safely back in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, as a token of my gratitude...
Please take an accessory if you'd like.
I hope you find something to your liking.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Well now.
I shall have a look.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My... Yellow gold, pink gold,
silver, platinum...
What an elegant shine they have.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
This pendant has a tiara motif.
It's a design that flatters the décolletage. Heheh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After much agonizing, I had the one item I chose wrapped
and left the shop.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, let us visit again once the register is fixed.
One simply won't be enough, after all.
choice_data_list: You're right. That necklace you picked looked great on you.
Yeah. The necklace you picked out looked great on you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Naturally.
I chose something that suits you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She chose a silver necklace with a tiara motif embedded with a sapphire.
Recalling how it looked when she tried it on, I speak up.
choice_data_list: I'm surprised you chose a blue accessory.
The chain was the same color as that bat from earlier.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I am quite fond of blue as well.
In a hall themed around white, a dress as deep blue as the ocean floor truly stands out."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If we end up knowing each other for a long time,
perhaps I will show you one day.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes—you will please this lady
with some clever, charming words, won't you?
choice_data_list: ...I'll work hard in that area too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a satisfied giggle, she began to walk.
Catching a glimpse of her lovely, ladylike side
brought a smile to my face as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Indeed.
Perhaps that is why it struck a chord with me.
However—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"That necklace is far too modest
to commemorate today's events.
Let's see... for example..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRACK!! CRUNCH!! WHAM!!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Here you go. Take it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What she carefully placed in a small pouch and handed to me
was a bracelet made from the fragments of a metal bat
she had found lying by the road."
choice_data_list: (Did I make them mad after all...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gentildonna's back radiated an intense aura as she walked ahead. I resolved in my heart to bring her some sweets once we got back...
